title: Adaptive Prompting: Ad-hoc Prompt Composition for Social Bias Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on a machine learning methodology for improving social bias detection (stereotypes related to gender, race, etc.) through adaptive prompting. While it addresses the ethical challenge of AI bias and mentions religion as one category of bias in the appendix, it does not have a primary component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religious traditions, theological concepts, or formal moral/ethical frameworks.
